testingTools.confirmReset:
Reset all progress?

This wipes your quiz answers, matches, shortlist, AND every tracked application and task for this account. It cannot be undone.

overview.heading: Your applications
overview.emptyHint: Programs you start tracking will show up here.

emptyFiltered.title: Nothing matches that filter.
emptyFiltered.description: Try a different status or clear the search.

emptyNone.title: No applications yet.
emptyNone.description: Open any program page and hit “Save”. It'll show up here as one you're interested in.

nextStep.interested: Decide whether to apply. Move to Drafting when you start.
nextStep.draftingWithNotes: Finish the items in your notes, then submit.
nextStep.draftingNoNotes: Outline your documents and motivation letter.
nextStep.submitted: Wait for the program's decision. Watch your inbox.
nextStep.waitlisted: Stay close — reply quickly if a spot opens.
nextStep.accepted: Compare offers, then confirm your enrollment.
nextStep.rejected: Take a breath. Lean into your other applications.
nextStep.withdrawn: Archived. Remove if you'd like to clear it.

kanban.heading: Your task board

suggestions.heading: Quick start

documentStudio.heading: Document studio
documentStudio.description: Draft a CV or a program-specific cover letter with AI, then edit it into your own. Drafts only use facts you give — gaps become [placeholders], never invented details.
documentStudio.tailorAriaLabel: Optionally tailor the CV to a tracked program
documentStudio.coverLetterProgramAriaLabel: Program the cover letter is for
documentStudio.coverLetterNeedsProgram: Track a program first — a cover letter is always written for a specific application.
documentStudio.highlightsLabel: Your background, in your own words
documentStudio.highlightsPlaceholderCv: Education dates, internships and jobs (employer, role, what you did), projects, skills, certificates… Turkish is fine — the draft comes out in English.
documentStudio.highlightsPlaceholderCoverLetter: Why this program? Relevant courses, projects, work experience, what you want to do after… Turkish is fine — the letter comes out in English.
documentStudio.charsRemaining: Add at least {count} more {count, plural, one {character} other {characters}} — a CV needs real facts to draft from.
documentStudio.quizTip: Tip: <link>take the quiz</link> so drafts also know your goals and English level.
documentStudio.popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the print window — allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
documentStudio.placeholdersTitle: Fill in the placeholders before exporting
documentStudio.placeholdersDescription: Only the PDF gets these values — the saved draft keeps its placeholders. Leave a field blank to keep it as-is.
documentStudio.reviewFooter: Always review before sending — fill every [placeholder] and check facts. AI drafts are a starting point, not a finished application.
